text.en:
This is the umbrella workflow that coordinates all envelope layers.
Ensure the complete exterior wall assembly is built in the correct sequence, with compatible approved materials, continuous control layers, correct drainage and ventilation paths, and proper integration at openings and interfaces.
A typical exterior wall may include:
interior finish → vapour control → framing → insulation → sheathing → air barrier → exterior insulation → drainage cavity → flashing → cladding/masonry
But the actual Hochelaga assembly must come from the approved project documents.
text.fr: cela is le umbrella workflow cela coordinates all envelope layers. Ensure le complete mur extérieur assemblage is built dans le corriger séquence, avec compatible approuvé matériaux, continuous contrôler layers, corriger drainage et ventilation paths, et proper integration à openings et interfaces. A typical mur extérieur peut include: interior finish → vapour contrôler → cadrage → isolation → sheathing → pare-air → exterior isolation → drainage cavity → solin → revêtement extérieur/maçonnerie mais le réel Hochelaga assemblage doit come de le approuvé documents du projet.

text.en:
This is one of the highest-priority envelope QC modules.
Create a continuous, durable, properly bonded and sealed air-control layer across the entire envelope, including joints, penetrations, openings and transitions.
The biggest air-barrier failures are rarely in the middle of a large flat membrane.
They occur at:
edges → corners → penetrations → openings → transitions → structural interfaces.
text.fr: cela is one de le highest-priority envelope QC modules. Create a continuous, durable, correctement bonded et sealed air-contrôler layer across le entire envelope, including joints, penetrations, openings et transitions. le biggest air-barrier failures are rarely dans le middle de a large flat membrane. They occur à: edges → corners → penetrations → openings → transitions → structural interfaces.

Maintain the intended vapour-control layer continuously and in the correct location within the wall/roof assembly to limit moisture migration and condensation risk.
The correct location and permeability depend on the designed wall assembly.
Do not assume “vapour barrier always goes on the warm side” without checking project design.
